System: RegionalOffice-Awareness
Assessment focus: AT-2 (Literacy Training and Awareness)

The annual awareness campaign is complete for 98% of active personnel. Two non-privileged call-center employees are five days past the training due date because they were on extended leave. Their accounts are limited to the call-center application and cannot administer systems or export bulk records. Automated reminders and manager follow-up are active.
